summary: Tested Calendar-Meetings integration. Backend API 11/11 tests passed. Frontend testing shows meetings from MongoDB calendar events are correctly displayed on /meetings page with all required data (title, date, time, description, video status, participants).

Backend: POST /api/calendar/events creates event visible on meetings page
Backend: Meeting card data format matches MeetingCard.jsx requirements
Backend: DELETE /api/calendar/events/{id} removes event from meetings
Backend: GET /api/calendar/events/{id} returns single event details
Backend: PUT /api/calendar/events/{id} updates meeting data
Backend: Stats counts match actual events data
Backend: Non-existent event returns 404
Backend: user_id is required for getting events
Backend: video_call_link auto-generated when video_call=true
Backend: Creator info included in event response
Frontend: Meetings Dashboard loads correctly
Frontend: Calendar events from MongoDB displayed on /meetings page
Frontend: Meeting cards show title, date, time, description
Frontend: Meeting cards show video status (Munal Video badge)
Frontend: Meeting cards show participant count
Frontend: Join button visible on meeting cards
Frontend: Open Calendar button navigates to /calendar
Frontend: Quick Schedule button opens scheduler modal
Frontend: Stats widget shows correct total and upcoming counts
Frontend: Next Up widget shows upcoming meetings
Frontend: Search, Filter, Sort controls present
Frontend: Schedule New button in sidebar works
